summary: BioStem Technologies filed an 8-K reporting a September 29, 2026 securities purchase agreement with institutional investors for a roughly $3.0 million private placement of 735,296 common shares at $4.08, plus Series A and Series B warrants for up to 735,296 shares each at $3.83. The placement closed September 30, 2026, with proceeds for working capital. Warrants are immediately exercisable, with five-year and 24-month terms, subject to 4.99% or 9.99% blocker, 30-day issuance standstill, and six-month variable-rate prohibition. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium was disclosed; watch warrant overhang and dilution.
